title: Power BI Inactive Account Reclamation
dataSources: Power BI admin refreshes (`powerbi:admin:refreshes`), admin API (`powerbi:admin:api`), gateway logs, and capacity metrics.
app: Power BI activity events from the Microsoft 365 / Purview audit log and the Power BI Admin & Fabric Capacity Metrics APIs via HEC scripted inputs.
spl:
index=bi sourcetype=powerbi:admin:api
| stats max(_time) as last_seen by user_email
| eval days_idle=round((now()-last_seen)/86400)
| where days_idle>60
| sort - days_idle
description: Lists Power BI accounts with no activity in over 60 days so administrators can reclaim licenses and reduce the access surface.
value: Idle Power BI accounts waste license spend and widen the attack surface; a periodic reclamation list turns both into routine housekeeping.
implementation: Ingest Power BI activity events; schedule monthly and route the idle-account list to identity/license owners.
visualization: Table of account by days idle, reclamation candidate list.

references.title: Power BI — Track user activities / audit log

grandmaExplanation: We find Power BI accounts nobody uses anymore so their licences can be freed and access tidied up.
